DL.name: Delta Air Lines
DL.description: Delta Main includes snacks and non-alcoholic drinks on eligible flights. Main Basic limits seat choice and flexibility; baggage exemptions depend on the ticket and traveler.

WN.name: Southwest Airlines
WN.description: Southwest now uses assigned seating. Basic normally receives its seat at check-in, while eligible fares and loyalty benefits offer earlier seat selection.

B6.name: JetBlue
B6.description: JetBlue includes a carry-on and personal item with every fare. Main Base charges for advance seat selection and changes or cancellations; standard and Flex fares provide more flexibility.

AA.name: American Airlines
AA.description: American includes one carry-on and one personal item. Checked bags and advance seat selection can cost extra on Basic Economy; rules depend on route and ticket date.

NK.name: Spirit Airlines
NK.description: Spirit’s official site reports that all flights are canceled as the airline winds down operations. Confirm refund information with Spirit before making travel plans.

F9.name: Frontier Airlines
F9.description: Frontier sells bags and seat selection separately from its lowest fares. Bundles can include a carry-on, seat selection and waived change or cancellation fees.

AS.name: Alaska Airlines
AS.description: Alaska Saver includes a carry-on and personal item with Main Cabin onboard service. Seat assignments and ticket changes are restricted, and cancellation credit depends on how early you cancel.

SY.name: Sun Country Airlines
SY.description: Sun Country’s base fare includes a seat and personal item. Carry-on bags, checked bags and advance seat selection cost extra; onboard entertainment streams to your own device.

MX.name: Breeze Airways
MX.description: Breeze offers a No Flex fare with a personal item and optional paid extras. Nice adds a carry-on and flexibility; Nicer and Nicest add seating and baggage benefits.

G4.name: Allegiant Air
G4.description: Allegiant includes a small personal item with its base fare. Carry-on and checked bags are paid extras, with prices varying by route and when you add them.

AC.name: Air Canada
AC.description: Air Canada’s Economy Basic restricts carry-on baggage on eligible North American and sun routes. Standard and higher fares have different baggage, seating and flexibility benefits.

AM.name: Aeroméxico
AM.description: Aeroméxico’s cabin baggage allowance depends on fare and route. Basic and Classic differ in advance seat selection and baggage benefits; check the exact ticket conditions.

AV.name: Avianca
AV.description: Avianca includes a carry-on in its lowest international fare within the Americas. Domestic Basic has a different allowance, and checked baggage and seat selection depend on fare.

XP.name: Avelo Airlines
XP.description: Avelo offers AveloFlex as a paid option for a one-time change or cancellation without a penalty. Standard ticket penalties increase closer to departure, and canceled bookings generally return Avelo Cash.

BA.name: British Airways
BA.description: British Airways Basic tickets receive an allocated seat at check-in unless you pay to choose earlier. Advance seat selection benefits depend on fare, cabin and frequent flyer status.

KX.name: Cayman Airways
KX.description: Cayman Airways includes cabin baggage on international jet services. Tampa economy travelers pay for checked bags, with a lower fee available through the website or app.

CM.name: Copa Airlines
CM.description: Copa Economy Basic includes a 10 kg carry-on. Checked bags and advance regular or Premium seat selection cost extra; other fare families provide different benefits.

4Y.name: Discover Airlines
4Y.description: Discover’s long-haul Economy includes entertainment, a hot meal and non-alcoholic drinks. Economy Light excludes the checked bag included with other Economy fares.

WK.name: Edelweiss Air
WK.description: Edelweiss long-haul economy includes a 23 kg checked bag and an 8 kg carry-on. Economy Saver charges for advance seats and rebooking and does not allow cancellation refunds.

PD.name: Porter Airlines
PD.description: Porter Basic includes a personal item and complimentary beer, wine and snacks. A standard carry-on, advance seat selection and checked bags require extra payment or an eligible bundle.

VS.name: Virgin Atlantic
VS.description: Virgin Atlantic Economy Light includes a 10 kg cabin bag without checked baggage. Economy Classic and Delight each include a 23 kg checked bag.

WS.name: WestJet
WS.description: WestJet UltraBasic includes a personal item. A carry-on is generally excluded on Tampa routes unless the Extended Comfort exception applies; other fares include cabin baggage.
